$comment: Central tunables for Invoice Matching. Env overrides via process.env.

matching.$comment: Tolerances when comparing invoice line vs PO line. priceTolPct is +/- percent of unit cost; qtyTolPct is +/- percent of ordered qty; absDollarTol is a flat $ ceiling regardless of percent (so tiny invoices don't auto-pass).

ai.$comment: model MUST be a live API id. 'claude-sonnet-4-6' was pinned here previously and is not a valid id, so every call would have 404'd. Current ids: claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5, claude-haiku-4-5. maxCandidates caps how many shortlisted docs get sent to the model per fuzzy-match call; minConfidence is the floor below which a proposal is not surfaced to AP at all.
